pages.text: Gravity is gentle here. You jump higher, fall slower, and take less fall damage (and from a greater height). Projectiles fly flatter. The effect applies while you are in the dimension.

It is always dim twilight under $(thing)Veyra$(), the great pale moon. Carry light — or harvest the native glow. Many hostiles $(o)flee bright light$(): daylight, a Stillbloom's core, lanterns, and Lumen light all keep them at bay.
